item.title: Some transgender folks in Lawrence balance uncertainty, resistance in face of new bathroom bill
item.description: Some local transgender folks are balancing fear, uncertainty and resilience as public agencies in Lawrence scramble to understand how to enforce Kansas’ new anti-trans bathroom legislation. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Humane Pet of the Week: Squishy-faced Azalea blooms when not confined to a kennel
item.description: Azalea, a 3-year-old pit bull, is calm, cuddly and kind when she’s not cooped up at the shelter. Continue reading ...

item.title: Transgender people in Lawrence lack answers about enforcement around invalidated driver’s licenses
item.description: Transgender people in Lawrence — and former residents who left the country to avoid persecution — have been swept up in the statewide confusion about enforcing anti-trans legislation that invalidates driver’s licenses with corrected gender markers. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence compost facility reopening for the season
item.description: The City of Lawrence's compost facility is set to open for the season on Saturday, March 7. Continue reading ...

item.title: For a welcoming adult choir in Lawrence, singing brings connections, joy
item.description: Crescendo, an adult choir in Lawrence with a "come one, come all" attitude, wants every voice to shine, regardless of musical experience. They’ll showcase their harmonies at an upcoming concert with a local children's choir. Continue reading ...

item.title: KU faculty union, administrators reach tentative contract agreement after nearly 2 years
item.description: After nearly two years of bargaining, the KU faculty union has reached a tentative agreement with administrators, union leaders announced Friday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas House introduces bill creating sports authority needed to complete Chiefs stadium deal
item.description: The Kansas House introduced legislation Friday authorizing creation of a state sports authority to allow construction of a publicly owned stadium spectacular enough to convince the Kansas City Chiefs to move from Missouri to Kansas. Continue reading ...

item.title: No charges filed in fatal Lawrence City Hall shooting
item.description: The Douglas County district attorney's office announced Friday that it will not file charges against anyone in January's fatal shooting inside Lawrence City Hall. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawyers for Kansas state departments see benefit to monthlong delay in enforcing anti-transgender bill
item.description: Legal representatives for two Kansas state departments said Friday that there would be benefits to delaying the enforcement of a new anti-transgender bill for another month, drawing an apparent concession from AG Kris Kobach. Continue reading ...

item.title: F-Mart has closed, but plans are in the works for an Afro-Asian shop to help fill a cultural gap in Lawrence
item.description: The closing of F-Mart, Lawrence’s sole Asian grocery store, has highlighted a gap in Asian representation in Lawrence but opened up the opportunity for a new Afro-Asian concept. Continue reading ...
